text:
Harper Lin: Quick sync  noticed Leads showing briefly as unassigned during APAC morning. pattern seems different from the usual bulk-import windows.
Diego Morales: Saw that too. HubSpot webhooks delayed? or enrichment worker starvation?
Sofia Ruiz: Could be both. Proposal: lightweight tri-point probe: webhook_recv -> enrich_done -> rr_assigned. Keep it salted+hashed, no PII.
Ben Cho: +1. Also capture `assign_path` (rr|fallback|manual), `fallback_reason`, and `connector` (hs|sf). sample 7% to start.
Harper Lin: Add `sla_tier` (gold|standard) and `weekday_or_weekend`. marketing needs to show SLA variance by tier.
Diego Morales: Add `first_sdr_touch_ts` when available so we know real business handoff latency.
Sofia Ruiz: Operational: funnel these events to topic `inbound.handoff.probes.v2` -> small consumer will emit prometheus metrics and a Console card. retention raw 7d, aggregates 180d.
Ben Cho: Alerting idea: page oncall if p95 end-to-end > 180s for >5% of sampled events over 10m, and separate alert if `fallback_rate` > 2% sustained 15m.
Harper Lin: Also want a metric for `rr_fairness_skew` measured per-owner over a 1h window. If any owner >3x expected share, flag and run a fairness replay.
Diego Morales: Respect tenant opt-out via metadata.probe=false and only sample paid customers by default. legal confirmed hashing + salt per-tenant is fine.
Sofia Ruiz: Payload sketch (one-liner): {lead_hash:sha256:...,connector:hubspot,recv:3177777600,enrich:3177777625,assigned:3177777630,assign_path:rr,sla_tier:gold,slo_breach:false}
Ben Cho: Dashboard: split by connector (HS vs SF), sla_tier, and timezone buckets. include small sparklines for backlog and connector_batch_size correlation.
Harper Lin: Rollout plan: internal tenant full sample 24h -> 7% prod 72h -> 30% 5d -> aggregated-only. Canary auto-disable if canary p95 > 4m and notify @ops.
Diego Morales: Dev owners: I'll own the consumer + hashing tests, Sofia add dashboard ticket, Ben owns alert config.
Sofia Ruiz: Creating ticket MKT-5177 "Handoff probes v2: SLA tiers, connector split, fairness metric" and assigning @Diego + @Ben.
ConnectorBot: hubspot webhook received portal=1203 event=hb_1203 at 3177777610
Ben Cho: Note: include `backlog_depth` snapshot for enrichment queue to tie spikes to worker saturation.
Harper Lin: Also consider a small backfill job that can re-run assignment for leads that hit default-owner fallback within 10m to recover fairness. mark as opt-in per-tenant.
Diego Morales: Good idea. We'll add a `backfill_attempted` flag to events so we can track recovery rate.
Sofia Ruiz: Timeline? Diego -> PR by Tue EOD, staging run Wed, prod canary next Mon.
Harper Lin: Thanks team. After staging run we draft a short customer note for Sales/CS explaining improved visibility and the fallback mitigation path. :rocket:
